scope: One observable curved panel shell study; fixing set not manufactured from unknown positions. No texture to hide uncertain sections.
exact_variant: Current official RDC 125HD longvisor appearance; isolated PF181209 linked BM150 references conditional.

width_m.reason: Cockpit-relative candidate extent, not published or calibrated from global bike width.

developed_height_m.reason: Loose-panel visible aspect used conditionally; camera unknown.

rake_from_vertical_deg.reason: Current official side silhouette shows substantial rearward rake; uncalibrated side-image hypothesis, not physical measurement.

centreline_bottom_world_m.reason: Initial cockpit interface placement to test against actual source instruments.

transverse_wrap_sag_m.reason: Related inner oblique photo establishes wrap, not its depth.

thickness_m.reason: Finite shell, no detailed thickness published.

edge_radius_m.reason: Working molded-sheet edge transition, not photo-measured.

construction: Fit a smooth source outline to manually observed bare-panel points, preserving low-corner reliefs and curved crown.
Distribute interior vertices in the planar domain before curving; constrained polygon triangulation plus conforming subdivision avoids a curved nonplanar n-gon.
Apply an analytic transverse wrap and rake, derive actual surface normals, then offset rear surface along those normals for finite wall thickness.
Close perimeter with an intentional small source edge transition; inspect diffuse and specular views before material.
Export the isolated shell study and inspect real buffers before final renders.
conditional_projection_check: Under a front orthographic hypothesis, aspect 285/250*cos(42deg)≈0.847, similar to official visible front envelope about92/110≈0.836. Occlusion/perspective make this only an order-of-proportion check, not a camera fit or dimensional calibration.
